description: COPY THIS FILE to <ecosystem>.json and fill it in. Every field below is optional except id, dir, and metrics. See references/adding-an-ecosystem.md.
post_add_fixup: Quirks of the add command: does it pin exact, move sections, rewrite ranges?

transitive_pin.note: Ship pins as their own PR. NOT [patch.crates-io] -- a patch must point at a different source (git or path) and cannot select another published crates.io version. If the resolver will not take the version, add it to [dependencies] as an exact pin instead.

add_lock_only: cargo update -p {pkg} --precise {version}  # surgical form, if the ecosystem has one
baseline_tools_note: Packages that PRODUCE your metrics (linter, type checker, test runner). Bumping one invalidates count-comparison.
